capabilities.title: Machine-readable process ownership
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Make later process syncs allowlisted and protect project-owned customizations.

capabilities.title: Guarded dry-run-first process sync
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Reduce manual merge risk across repeated Mamkin updates.

capabilities.title: Subagent, separate-task, and two-track routing
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Use cheaper bounded subagents while retaining durable isolation where needed.

capabilities.title: Feature branch and Git closeout contract
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Make branch choice, local commits, integration authority, and post-acceptance cleanup predictable for every feature.

capabilities.title: Change-aware validation planning
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Run relevant checks without paying for unrelated validation.

capabilities.title: Prompt regression contracts
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Prevent prompt and routing simplifications from silently weakening behavior.

capabilities.title: Measured role model and reasoning routing
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Lower model cost only where same-case quality evidence supports it.

capabilities.title: Optional post-edit formatter
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Remove repeated formatting cleanup when a safe deterministic formatter exists.

capabilities.title: Context audit, reset, and rollover
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Recover long-running coordinators from stale assumptions without restarting blindly.

capabilities.title: Secret-shaped text scan hook
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Catch common secret-shaped text before it spreads into prompts, files, or commits.

capabilities.title: Turn closeout reminder hook
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Surface missing validation and trust notes before final handoff.

capabilities.title: Project-native capability mining
capabilities.benefitHypothesis: Turn repeated project lessons into the smallest profitable source, check, skill, consolidation, or upstream candidate without leaking domain details.
